# omniddi_ipam_address (Resource)

Allocates the next free IPv4 or IPv6 address in an IPAM subnet and records `name` on it. OmniDDI picks the lowest free host address outside the subnet's DHCP pools, so parallel applies never get the same one. The address stays the same across plans; changing `subnet_id` or `name` allocates a new one. Pass `ip_address` to an `omniddi_dns_record` to publish it in DNS in the same apply. OmniDDI has no API that releases an address, so destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state and the address stays allocated in OmniDDI. Some OmniDDI versions allocate only in subnets attached to a DHCP server group and otherwise answer `SUBNET_NOT_ALLOCATABLE`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omniddi_ipam_subnet" "app" {
  cidr = "10.10.1.0/24"
}

data "omniddi_dns_zone" "corp" {
  name      = "corp.example.com"
  view_name = "internal"
}

resource "omniddi_ipam_address" "web" {
  subnet_id = data.omniddi_ipam_subnet.app.id
  name      = "web-01.corp.example.com"
  exclude   = ["10.10.1.1"]
}

resource "omniddi_dns_record" "web" {
  zone_id = data.omniddi_dns_zone.corp.id
  name    = "web-01"
  type    = "A"
  values  = [omniddi_ipam_address.web.ip_address]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Hostname or FQDN recorded on the address in OmniDDI, compared without regard to case or a trailing dot. Changing it allocates a new address. Later edits to the hostname in OmniDDI are not tracked.
- `subnet_id` (Number) ID of the IPAM subnet to allocate from (`omniddi_ipam_subnet.id`). Changing it allocates a new address.

### Optional

- `exclude` (Set of String) Addresses never to allocate, at most 100, in the subnet's address family. Used only when the address is allocated; changing it later does not move the address.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The OmniDDI id of the address record.
- `ip_address` (String) The allocated address.
- `status` (String) Status of the address in OmniDDI, `Used` once allocated.
- `subnet_cidr` (String) CIDR of the subnet holding the address.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import omniddi_ipam_address.web 812
terraform import omniddi_ipam_address.web 10.10.1.0/24/10.10.1.2
```
